messages.subject: May 2025 introductory distance sampling workshop registration open for you
parts:
March is behind us and the warmer month 🌷of April (at least in the northern hemisphere) has arrived.

Registration is open for another three weeks for the May 05-16 introductory workshop. I encourage you consider attending the May workshop. If you have curiosity about the finer points of conventional distance sampling, this is the workshop where you can have those issues addressed.

The last two offerings of this workshop have been over-subscribed, so I encourage you to register well ahead of the close of registration on 23April. If you would like to discuss how the workshop may be of benefit to you, I'd be happy to discuss with you; send me a note.

Direct link to the workshop registration page through the St Andrews online shop is below:

https://onlineshop.st-andrews.ac.uk/conferences-and-events/events/creem/online-live-workshop-introductory-distance-sampling-monday-5th-may-friday-16th-may-2025
